hits.snippet: # Top MarTech News From the Week of August 7th: Updates from Pipedrive, Klaviyo, Thryv, and More ## **Top MarTech News From the Week of August 7th** **, 2026** ### [**ASAPP Appoints a CEO**](https://www.asapp.com/press/asapp-appoints-katie-stein-as-ceo-to-accelerate-ai-transformation-of-the-contact-center) ASAPP, a Customer Experience Platform (CXP) for the agentic enterprise, has appointed Katie Stein as chief executive officer. With over 20 years of executive leadership spanning strategy, growth, operations, and technology transformation, Stein will lead ASAPP through its next phase of growth. She says, “I strongly believe that AI will not replace human ingenuity, and ASAPP’s unique approach in human-in-the-loop (HILA) brings the right human to the right decision point, putting the focus on outcomes through the best use of automation and people. I’m excited to lead that charge and help our customers build AI they can trust and transform what’s possible in customer experience.” [**Read on for more.**](https://www.asapp.com/press/asapp-appoints-katie-stein-as-ceo-to-accelerate-ai-transformation-of-the-contact-center)

hits.title: ASAPP Appoints Priya Vijayarajendran as CEO | ASAPP
hits.snippet: [ASAPP Adds Continuous Red Teaming to CXP to Build Trust in Enterprise AI Learn More](https://www.asapp.com/press/asapp-adds-continuous-red-teaming-to-its-customer-experience-platform) ASAPP Appoints Priya Vijayarajendran as CEO Veteran technology executive expands ASAPP's market-leading AI-powered software for contact centers **NEW YORK, NY., March 4, 2025 –** [ASAPP](https://www.asapp.com/) , the leading provider of AI-powered contact center software, today appointed [Priya Vijayarajendran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/priyavijayarajendran/) to the position of CEO. As ASAPP's former CTO and president of technology, Vijayarajendran brings three decades of AI and software leadership at global enterprises including Microsoft, IBM and SAP. "Our goal at ASAPP is clear - to be the industry leader in AI for contact centers," said Priya Vijayarajendran, CEO of ASAPP. "Achieving our goal means advancing our best-in-class products, and helping our customers quickly realize the measurable economic and goodwill value of our offerings. ASAPP is uniquely positioned with the talent, domain expertise, technology, and momentum to make our goal a reality, and I'm proud to lead our unmatched team."
